def: something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax)

occurrences.text: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
